breaking.title: ​RBI Proposes Stop Switch to Let Bank Customers Block All Outgoing Digital Payments
breaking.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has proposed a new set of security measures aimed at protecting bank customers from cyber fraud and unauthorized transactions ​The proposed stop switch forms a central part of the RBI’s preventive security framework. By activating this feature, customers can immediately block all future outgoing digital debit transactions from their accounts. Once switched on, account holders will be unable to initiate digital payments, create new payment mandates, set up fresh standing instructions, or register their accounts for UPI on new third-party payment applications. ​However, the stop switch will not freeze all account activity.

breaking.title: ​SEBI Takes Strict View on IPO Grey Market, Warns of Zero Exchange Protection in Disputes
breaking.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has adopted a strict stance regarding the grey market premium (GMP) associated with initial public offerings ​The market regulator has formally advised against the promotion and dissemination of grey market premium data linked to upcoming IPOs. Ahead of a company’s formal listing on recognized bourses, grey market premiums often circulate widely, influencing investor perception. By calling for a halt to the publicity of GMP figures, SEBI aims to prevent the spread of unregulated indicators that lack institutional oversight.
